description:
Back our Kickstarter at:
https://kickstarter.adventureisnigh.horse

And Subscribe to:
@AdventureIsNighOfficial 

Adventure Is Nigh! is an animated tabletop RPG show: we play real games with real dice rolls, then animate over the footage to bring these ridiculous stories to life. After five seasons, two Side Quests and 65 episodes, we are now moving to our very own YouTube channel, launching a brand-new standalone story (Mist Riders), and building a home for all kinds of tabletop RPG nonsense!

Subscribe so you don't miss Mist Riders or any of the other exciting new shows we'll be doing here at Adventure Is Nigh!

WHAT YOUR SUPPORT DOES
Your pledge covers the Mist Riders shoot we've already paid for, the other content we filmed alongside it, and getting your rewards to you.

REWARDS
• Name in the credits and behind-the-scenes access
• Digital wallpaper pack and Adventure Is Nigh! digital collection
• Signed Blu-rays
• An exclusive Kickstarter T-shirt
• Red Dragon Inn: Adventure Is Nigh
title: A New Channel, the Next Adventure is Nigh Campaign, and a Kickstarter!
